title: Books
html:
Books are readable items in Baldur's Gate 3. Reading them might start or update Quests or trigger a cutscene. Most of them provide world or character lore.

Other organizational groupings of books can be found in:

  • Category:Books
  • Books by Subject
  • Books by Author

In addition, other forms of written material can be found on these pages:

  • Notes - includes a list of letters, notes, maps, and other short written material
    • Category:Notes
    • Notes by Author
  • Slates - includes a list of readable slates, stone tablets, and other carved material
    • Category:Slates
    • Githyanki Slates - provides a descriptive list of Tir'su Slates
